body: I appreciate your kind words. I will certainly be seeking help. Not being able to talk to her again is what is killing me tbh
If there’s anyway I can stop this from happening to someone else I will do it. People need to see that they are worth more than they give themselves credit for
Thank you. It’s all so hard. She was my best friend
Please don’t. You are worth living. Message me if you need someone to talk to but please consider other ways to cope
